mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_reservation(reservation_id, order_id, status, expire_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{orderId}, #{status}, #{expireAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO stock_reservation_item(reservation_id, sku_id, quantity) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, reservation_id, sku_id, quantity FROM stock_reservation_item WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY sku_id
